$schemaComment: Disposable Maestro ownership/claim fixture roles (#574 / #607). Labels come from .env.maestro - never hardcode shared QA project chapters here.
description: Deterministic assignment roles for a dedicated disposable Fluent project. Run npm run maestro:fixtures:verify before ownership Maestro suites.

mine.notes: Assigned to MAESTRO_EMAIL (Draft or Not Started). Used for My Work + project-list mine icon.

other.notes: Assigned to MAESTRO_EMAIL_2 (or peerChecker ≠ MAESTRO_EMAIL at Peer Check). Taken-warning Record path.

unassigned.notes: No assignee / open ownership. List shows no ownership icon; Record has no taken warning.

claim.notes: Disposable unassigned chapter for online auto-claim. Seed restores via PATCH reset-selected (fluent-api#464); 404 falls back to rotating this label.

conflict.notes: Chapter with hasConflict=true (verified via GET chapter-assignments/progress). Seeded by three verse-audio takes; the third uses a stale baseVersionToken.

openPeerCheck.notes: Peer Check with no peerChecker. Seed: assign-selected MAESTRO_EMAIL_2 as drafter, then that translator PATCH submit.
